messages.text:
"Game: NEON BLASTER – Space ShooterBuild a complete 2D arcade space shooter called NEON BLASTER.

Control a spaceship, destroy enemy ships and survive increasingly difficult waves.

Include:

- Smooth spaceship movement.
- Shooting and special attacks.
- Different enemy types.
- Three boss battles.
- Collectible power-ups.
- Score and high-score system.
- Explosions and particle effects.
- Starfield background.
- Mobile touch controls.
- Start, pause, victory and game-over screens.

Focus on responsive controls, lightweight code and reliable gameplay. Test all features.
"
